# proxmox_node_ceph_restart_bulk (Resource)

Restarts Ceph daemons in bulk through `POST /nodes/{node}/ceph/restart-bulk`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_restart_bulk" "r" {
  node         = "pve-1"
  service_type = "osd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean)
- `only_outdated` (Boolean)
- `service_type` (String)
- `set_noout` (Boolean)
- `timeout` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
